```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
ledger <- outcome_ledger(risk)
p <- plot_outcome_ledger(ledger) +
  labs(
    title = "Share of eligible seasons ending in each NFL outcome",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Eligible player-seasons with a known outcome, draft classes ",
      min(risk$draft_year),
      " to ",
      max(risk$draft_year)
    ),
    x = "Share of eligible seasons",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "outcome-ledger", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-round
by_round <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d) |>
  count(round = outcome_draft_round_d, name = "n") |>
  mutate(per100 = 100 * n / nrow(risk))
p_round <- ggplot(by_round, aes(factor(round), per100)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Round %d: %s eligible seasons drafted, %.2f in every 100",
        round,
        fmt(n),
        per100
      ),
      data_id = round
    ),
    fill = "#1B9E77",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Eligible seasons drafted in each round",
    subtitle = "Per hundred eligible seasons with a known outcome",
    x = "Draft round",
    y = "Per 100 eligible seasons",
    caption = "Hover a bar for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_round)
```

```{r}
#| label: ledger-table
rounds <- tibble(
  outcome = c(
    "  Drafted, round 1",
    "  Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
    "  Drafted, rounds 4 to 7"
  ),
  events = c(
    sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d == 1L),
    sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3),
    sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d >= 4L)
  )
)
n_seasons <- nrow(risk)
bind_rows(
  ledger[1, c("outcome", "events")],
  rounds,
  ledger[2:3, c("outcome", "events")]
) |>
  mutate(
    lo = vapply(events, \(x) wilson(x, n_seasons)[["lo"]], numeric(1)),
    hi = vapply(events, \(x) wilson(x, n_seasons)[["hi"]], numeric(1)),
    interval = paste(pct(lo), "to", pct(hi)),
    share = pct(events / n_seasons),
    at_risk = fmt(n_seasons),
    events = fmt(events)
  ) |>
  select(outcome, events, at_risk, share, interval) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Outcome", "Seasons", "Eligible seasons", "Share", "95% interval"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Each outcome over the ",
      fmt(n_seasons),
      " eligible seasons of ",
      fmt(n_distinct(risk$playerId)),
      " players, with the draft split by round. A player usually has several eligible seasons, and his NFL entry, if any, falls on exactly one of them."
    )
  )
```
